<timestamp>Sunday, Sep 13, 2026, 7:32 PM (UTC+5:30)</timestamp>
<user_query>
Events on the last day of the week aren't showing up in the "This week" filter
on the homepage. The Robotics Club Social on Sunday 20 September is missing from
the list even though it's in the events data. Please fix it.
</user_query>
I'll investigate how the "This week" filter calculates its date range and why Sunday events are excluded.

todos.content: Find why Sunday events miss This week filter
Fix week bounds/filter and verify with tests

content.text: The range helper uses an exclusive end (`< end`), so Sunday (equal to the week end) is dropped. Checking whether the month filter has the same issue.

input.description: Run filter tests to confirm failure

content.text: Confirming the bug: `getEventsInRange` uses an exclusive end bound while week/month bounds are inclusive. Updating the comparison to include the end date.

input.old_string: return events.filter((event) => event.date >= start && event.date < end);
input.new_string: return events.filter((event) => event.date >= start && event.date <= end);

content.text:
Fixed. `getEventsInRange` treated the end date as exclusive (`< end`), so Sunday events equal to the week end were dropped.

Changed it to `<= end` so Monday–Sunday (and the full month range) are inclusive. The Robotics Club Social on 20 September now appears in "This week", and all filter tests pass.
